Seeds (MULTIRUN_BASE_SEED/SEED_OFFSET), stores (MULTIRUN_STORE_PARENT), CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER, and every mode knob were left to the ambient environment, whose cleanliness the campaign verified through its ambient-preauthorization machinery (ambient-preauthorized-set.json per arm).

v1_divergences.certified: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES cleared; placement via MTG_KERNEL_PILOT_CUDA_ORDINAL = device ordinal; CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER unmanaged
v1_divergences.v1: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES = pinned device UUID; MTG_KERNEL_PILOT_CUDA_ORDINAL always 0; CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER = PCI_BUS_ID
v1_divergences.justification: The bridge ordinal parse is lenient (absent/unparsable silently means 0, bridge.rs:418-425): under certified-style placement a typo stacks every process on device 0. UUID masking pins device identity in-record and makes the lenient parse unreachable. Placement mechanism changes; run semantics do not. Gate A3 (store byte-identity) and both confirmation legs validate on-device equivalence.
